pairs.subject: toasts-notifications

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/reviews/ReviewsSplitPane.tsx:153 Passes a retry action to BulkResultToast, which auto-dismisses after 10s and lacks hover/focus pause to protect the action window.

src/components/dashboard/views/reviews/reviews-focus-flow/focusSeverityConfig.ts:5 Configures visual tokens for review entity severity without mapping to dwell, dismissibility, ledger record, or announcement politeness.
src/components/dashboard/views/reviews/ReviewsSplitPane.tsx:50 Executes interval-based escalation checks without OS notification integration, platform permission lifecycle, or deep-linking.
